user.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Location
user.description: Coordinates only (never a postal code) — precision here matters for the microclimate correction this integration does. Defaults to your Home Assistant home location. Elevation is looked up automatically; enter a value below only if you have a more precise one (e.g. from a differential GPS survey).

station.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Local station
station.description: Select the sensor entities for your local weather station. Rain and wind can be added once your station supports them.

credentials.title: SwissWeather Fusion — API credentials
credentials.description: SRF, meteoblue, and Meteonomiqs credentials are required and obtained from their respective developer portals — see the README for links. The Open-Meteo key is optional: leave it blank for the free tier (no account needed) — it only raises rate limits on their paid tier, it does not make forecasts refresh more often. All credentials are stored securely and never written to a YAML file.

data.open_meteo_api_key: Open-Meteo API key (optional, paid tier only)

reauth_confirm.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Re-authenticate SRF
reauth_confirm.description: Your SRF (SRG SSR) consumer key/secret needs to be updated, e.g. after rotating it on their developer portal.

error.elevation_lookup_failed: Could not automatically look up elevation for these coordinates. Enter one manually, or check your network connection and try again.

init.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Options
init.description: Credential fields: leave blank to keep the existing value — a masked secret can't be shown for editing, and a blank submission won't erase a working credential.

data.srf_consumer_key: SRF (SRG SSR) consumer key (leave blank to keep existing)
data.srf_consumer_secret: SRF (SRG SSR) consumer secret (leave blank to keep existing)
data.meteoblue_api_key: meteoblue API key (leave blank to keep existing)
data.meteonomiqs_api_key: Meteonomiqs API key (leave blank to keep existing)
data.open_meteo_api_key: Open-Meteo API key (optional, paid tier only; leave blank to keep existing or stay on the free tier)
data.diagnostic_logging_enabled: Enable detailed diagnostic logging (off by default — turn on to capture detailed events for the Download Diagnostics button, then download and share when done)
